AERO has no entry: its report must be cmp-identical. Revenue, cost of revenue, holder flow and grades get no entry (brief Step 2); the only holder-flow / yields entries are LIT's and PUMP's dilution-derived fields (ruling R21: LIT rel 0.0007, supply.netPerYear abs 100000; PUMP rel 1e-12).
Entries with "todo": true are inert placeholders: the controller replaces each with the exact listing paths the first diff run shows (glob + reason) and drops the todo flag.
